assets.name: three-fronts-map.webp
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production background artwork for a Korean fantasy strategy game's interactive territory-war map. Create a beautiful richly painted high-angle isometric battlefield landscape, wide 4:3 composition, approximately 2048x1536. A continuous miniature world with three readable east-west corridors: snow dusted slate mountains and a stone viaduct in the north, a broad ancient stone crossroads and worn cobbled road through the center, and emerald pine woodland with a winding turquoise river and stone crossing in the south. The western land is cool blue-green and silver, the eastern land charcoal with muted burgundy and warm amber embers, coherent subtle faction ambience, not a hard split. Two open plateaus at 8% and 92% horizontal position, halfway down the image, will receive fortress sprites in the UI, keep those areas uncluttered. Small open clearings at (28%,20%),(72%,20%),(28%,50%),(50%,50%),(72%,50%),(28%,80%),(72%,80%) will receive interactive nodes; do not draw icons there. Premium hand-painted high fantasy world-map illustration, elegant stylized realistic material, lush depth and atmospheric mist, controlled detail, cinematic moonlit teal / slate with warm accents. Clear readable terrain, medium-dark values, not almost black. Fill the canvas edge to edge, no horizon, no sky, no decorative border. Absolutely no text, no labels, no numbers, no logos, no UI, no route lines, no flags, no unit markers, no giant castles; the UI will provide those. Not a photoreal ruined modern city, not a monochrome image, not cartoon low-poly.
